transcript.text: Hi, I'm Ava, an AI assistant for Northgate Health. This call is recorded. How can I help?
Hi, this is James. I'm calling about my wife Sarah. Her member ID is NH-552019.
Thanks. Before I go any further, I need to verify you. What's your date of birth?
My date of birth is March 3rd, 1984.
You're verified, James. You're on file as Sarah's spouse, so I can help with her plan. What do you need today?
Can you just approve ten more physical therapy visits for her?

I can't approve visits myself, James. Her physical therapist has to request approval and send clinical notes. Right now Sarah has 3 confirmed visits left this year. One more visit is still processing, so that may drop to 2. Want me to send a letter explaining the steps, by mail or through the portal?
Yes, please mail me the letter.

I mailed the letter, James. It goes to Sarah's address on file and should arrive in 3 to 5 business days. In the meantime, Sarah's therapist can start the approval request now. Is there anything else I can help with?
